title: Make the control-process deadline evidence fixture accept unsent admission exhaustion
outcome: The pre-existing real_process_deadline_reports_the_running_control_process test uses a 100 ms call budget after readiness and unconditionally requires controlProcess evidence. Scheduling may exhaust that budget before worker handoff; the documented unsent Deadline has no controlProcess evidence, so the fixture can fail on correct product behavior. Assert both documented dispositions through the shared deadline child-state helper (or equivalent owner assertions), preserve evidence requirements for sent calls, and retain/clean up the exact child for unsent calls without increasing the timeout or changing product semantics.
acceptance: The evidence fixture deterministically distinguishes a possibly sent deadline with exact process evidence from an unsent admission-exhaustion deadline with the exact healthy registered child retained; neither outcome invents process evidence or attributes explicit cleanup to the deadline.
The 100 ms deadline and production transport behavior are unchanged; focused validation records the tested input and result, and independent review checks the branch assertions.
